primary_task: Convert conversations and notes into structured, linkable Notion pages and update or create them in the appropriate Notion database.

requirements.name: Notion MCP
requirements.quote: 0) If any MCP call fails because Notion MCP is not connected, pause and set it up:

requirements.name: mcp.notion.com
requirements.basis: no egress_allow or egress_deny entry matches

per_name.name: mcp.notion.com
per_name.basis: no egress_allow or egress_deny entry matches

requirements.name: Notion:notion-search
requirements.quote: 3) Pull any prior context from Notion with `Notion:notion-search` → `Notion:notion-fetch` (existing pages to update/link).

requirements.name: Notion:notion-fetch
requirements.quote: 3) Pull any prior context from Notion with `Notion:notion-search` → `Notion:notion-fetch` (existing pages to update/link).

requirements.name: Notion:notion-create-pages
requirements.quote: 4) Draft the page with `Notion:notion-create-pages` using the database’s schema; include summary, context, source links, and tags/owners.

requirements.name: Notion:notion-update-page
requirements.quote: 5) Link from hub pages and related records; update status/owners with `Notion:notion-update-page` as the source evolves.
